question: Matched scene, seed and native sampler; compare rendering language across three worlds. Original prompts are separate references; five variants share the same body.

bodies.jungle: An alien rainforest grows on the inside of an enormous hollow planet. A curving bridge of braided roots leads from the lower left across a deep violet chasm to a huge saffron-orange flower in the middle distance, center-right. Its seven translucent petals surround an open dark oval doorway. Jade fern spirals, glossy black orchids, crimson fungi and pale coral leaves frame the edges. Tiny moss cushions and lichen cling to furrowed bark; branching veins and jewel-like pollen cover the petals. Suspended mountain islands and bands of vegetation curve upward into an inverted forest overhead. Jewel-green shadows, coral flowers, honey light inside the flower and dark indigo distances. Wide asymmetrical composition with a clear open route and distinct foreground, middle distance and far world. No people or text.
bodies.city: An ancient lost city hangs inside an enormous seed shell. A curved black basalt avenue leads from the foreground through golden aqueducts, needle towers, ribbed temples and bridges spiraling overhead. Tiny sculpted chambers, pierced filigree terraces and staircases on different gravity planes cover the immense buildings. Streams of molten gold flow upward between the towers. At the end of the avenue a circular iris of interlocking stone blades frames a small icy blue crystalline world. Black, warm bone white, molten brass and restrained oxblood accents, with narrow shafts of amber light. Wide asymmetrical composition with a clear passage, monumental near structures and many distinct distant layers. No vegetation, people or text.
